Ivys is a replicant, made from Kairos, as were Bekarys and Abagnale, but what are replicants?
Using the power of the Timekeeper's throne and Temporal Keystone, Kairos manifested other possibilities from destroyed timelines, Bekarys is Kairos if he was simply born in Terra-Nova and lived a more full and happy life as a merchant. Abagnale is the version of Kairos where he grew up in hardship, and never got to study magic having to steal to survive. But Ivys is different, Ivys is not another possible Kairos. 
When Kairos' rogue replicant Horus created his own replicants, he used other versions of himself, but the deteriorated very quickly and were much weaker. In an effort to create a replicant that could last long enough to defeat Kairos, Horus decided to stop pulling version of himself or Kairos, and tried to create a replicant from an alternate version of Lisa.
